name: Neetu Yoshi Ltd
tagline: SME-migrated (2025) Class-A railway foundry now with its capacity-doubling Haridwar plant LIVE (13-Sep-2026), a bold ~2x FY27 revenue guide and expanding RDSO approvals (27 products) -- but no moat, ~32% OPM widely doubted, and working-capital days that have doubled in a year
business_overview: Neetu Yoshi (incorporated 2020, SME-IPO 2025, ~Rs 51 Cr raised) is a RDSO-certified Class A ferrous foundry + CNC machine shop making critical safety spares for Indian Railways -- castings and assemblies for braking, suspension, propulsion and coupling systems, currently focused on the wagon segment as a component master. The new Haridwar (Uttarakhand) facility (funded by IPO proceeds) roughly doubles capacity, commenced commercial production 13-Sep-2026, and is the base for forward integration into complete bogies and couplers (RDSO approval received Mar-2026). Company has also built an in-house bid-assist tool ('Rail Intel') for the railway e-procurement portal.

Total income Rs 101.6 Cr (+43.5% YoY); revenue ~Rs 98 Cr; EBITDA Rs 33.9 Cr (~33% OPM); PAT Rs 25.0 Cr (+52% YoY)

fundamentals_narrative: Headline metrics remain outstanding -- ~32% ROCE, ~28% ROE, ~44% FY26 income growth, ~33% operating margin, near-debt-free -- but this is a company with barely two years of listed history on a very small base. The forum's own thesis author concedes there is 'no strong moat per se'; the working advantages are (1) the ~7.5% lifelong tax edge under Sec 115BAB, (2) RDSO Class-A certification (a real but not unique entry barrier), and (3) a favourable raw-material procurement cycle. This pass adds two things. Positive: the Haridwar plant is no longer a plan -- commercial production began 13-Sep-2026, roughly doubling capacity, and management has put out a specific, bold FY27 guide (~2x revenue, ~25% PAT margin). Negative: working-capital intensity has deteriorated sharply (debtor days 79->118, working-capital days 69->133 in a year), and the Rs 27.48 Cr warrant issue -- at Rs 104, below the then-market ~Rs 116, to promoters and others -- exists precisely to fund that. An independent tracker still expects OPM to normalise to 22-25% as the base scales.
technical_read: Not pulled. Migrated from the BSE SME platform; low float, low liquidity. Stock ran from ~Rs 116 (Aug-2026) to ~Rs 178 on the plant start.
sentiment_summary: Small thread (8 posts, all read). Started May-2026 by Amnesiac (trusted, elevated) with a detailed write-up framing it as a railway safety-spares component master riding the wagon cycle. Discussion is constructive but cautious: jagadishsabat flags high OPM and low tax rate as possibly IPO-optics (Amnesiac rebuts the tax point -- 115BAB is genuine and permanent); Ketan_Chheda (trusted) questions the Rs 27.5 Cr warrant issue for working capital; Satishwe (trusted) dings the company for pushing updates via WhatsApp instead of only NSE/BSE. ADI129 notes the new plant is live and order book is ~Rs 170 Cr. No trusted user has posted a firm buy conviction; no high-conviction call to log.
community_signal: Thread initiated by a trusted (elevated) user with a positive framing, but no explicit conviction call and several trusted users raising governance/disclosure nitpicks. Net: mildly positive interest, not a conviction signal. Not floor-active.

value_chain.theme: Railways / rolling-stock capex + defence-adjacent precision castings
value_chain.position: Component master (Class-A ferrous castings & machined assemblies) one tier below bogie/wagon builders; sells into Indian Railways and wagon OEMs; forward-integrating into bogies/couplers
value_chain.bottleneck_node: RDSO Class-A foundry certification + machining capacity for safety-critical rail spares (long product-level qualification cycle)
value_chain.note: Demand side (railway wagon + rolling-stock push) is real and multi-year; supply is being added (Neetu Yoshi itself doubling, plus peers), so the open question is whether a no-moat SME-scale foundry can hold ~30%+ margins as it scales and as the bogie/coupler line ramps.

bull_case: Exceptional returns on a small base: ROCE ~32%, ROE ~28% (3-yr ~40%), ~33% OPM, near-debt-free
Haridwar plant now LIVE (13-Sep-2026), roughly doubling capacity; management guides ~2x FY27 revenue (Rs 210-220 Cr) at ~25% PAT margin
RDSO approval (Mar-2026) extends the range to complete bogies and couplers; 27 products approved, >30 under approval -- a specific, expanding product-addition catalyst
Lifelong Sec 115BAB tax edge (~7.5% below peers); railway rolling-stock / wagon capex tailwind
bear_case: No competitive moat by the thesis author's own admission; RDSO cert is an entry barrier, not a moat
Working-capital intensity deteriorating fast (debtor days 79->118, WC days 69->133 in a year) -- growth funded by stretched receivables; hence the Rs 27.48 Cr warrant raise
~33% OPM widely doubted as unsustainable (independent tracker expects ~22-25%); margins likely at a peak
Warrant issue at Rs 104 -- below the then-market -- to promoters + others; SME-tier disclosure (WhatsApp updates); only ~2 years of listed history and an unproven 2x FY27 guide
Order book (~Rs 170 Cr) is only ~0.25x market cap; thinly followed; low float / liquidity
verdict_headline: Plant now live and FY26 delivered, but firmed-up quality concerns (peak-looking OPM, doubling working-capital days, below-market insider warrant) keep conviction at Medium and the thesis 'unconfirmed'
verdict_reasoning: Per the small-cap recent-inflection rule: a tiny ~Rs 690 Cr base, a strongly positive recent trajectory (FY26 income +43.5%, H2 PAT +58.6%), and a specific, dated catalyst (Haridwar plant commercial from 13-Sep-2026; expanding RDSO approvals) support a 10x-in-2-3-years tag -- but at Medium conviction with an 'unconfirmed' caveat.

Conviction held at Medium: the plant going live de-risks the capacity story and FY26 was delivered, but this pass firmed up the quality flags -- OPM ~32% looks like a peak for a no-moat foundry, working-capital days have doubled, and a below-market warrant issue to insiders funds the gap. management_quality assessed 'concern'.
Red-flag check: none (no negative net worth, no promoter-pledge collapse, no active SEBI action).
Re-check after H1 FY27 results: revenue tracking toward the Rs 210-220 Cr guide, OPM holding >25%, and working-capital days stabilising would move this toward Medium-High.
